_about.purpose: Labelled test cases: for each app, what the app DISPLAYS vs what the source SAYS, with the registry error id each discrepancy belongs to. Consumed by scripts/rapidmeta_error_sweep.py detector RM-V01 (value contradicts verified truth) and by the batch-remediation runs as the acceptance target.
_about.rule: Nothing in `truth` is from recall. Each entry carries `source` and, where a lookup was performed in this session, `verified_by`.

MITRAL_FUNCMR_REVIEW.html.topic: Transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER) for functional mitral regurgitation
MITRAL_FUNCMR_REVIEW.html.why: Textbook multi-error instance: scope-lock, arm reversal, recurrent-event coercion, KM-as-crude-count, cross-endpoint escalc pooling, RoB self-contradiction, false registry-status, device phase mislabel.
MITRAL_FUNCMR_REVIEW.html.scope_actually_bound: each trial's own PRIMARY composite, at three different timepoints

smoking_gun.why_wrong: 83/78 is MITRA-FR's 12-month composite, 139/170 is RESHAPE-HF2's 24-month RECURRENT composite (and its arms are reversed), 151/212 is COAPT's 24-month composite. Three different constructs at three timepoints pooled as one binary risk ratio.

composite_24mo.note: distinct from both the 12-month 83/78 the app displays and the 53/52 mortality

composite_12mo.note: what the app displays under a mortality scope label

denominators.rule: label both; do not use one silently for the other

primary.construct: RECURRENT HF hospitalisation or CV death
primary.note: a recurrent-event rate ratio, NOT a hazard ratio

truth.over_claim: "Confirms the COAPT pattern" is over-strong for MORTALITY: the mortality result is non-significant (p=0.09).

all_cause_mortality_24mo.PROHIBITED: Do NOT multiply the KM % by N to make crude counts. A KM estimate is a model-based cumulative incidence under censoring.

composite_24mo.note: what the app displays under a mortality scope label

hf_hospitalisation.PROHIBITED: not a patient percentage; 212/312 = 67.9% is a coincidence of the same number on a different scale

correct_analysis.method: generic inverse-variance on the three PUBLISHED mortality hazard ratios
correct_analysis.PROHIBITED: never pool the displayed binary counts

other_confirmed_errors.RM-G03: COAPT extraction evidence says D2 some-concerns / D4 low; the chart chip shows D2 high / D4 high. GRADE text says 'majority high on D1/D4' while its own table shows D1 low in all three.
other_confirmed_errors.RM-D08: app asserts '0/3 posted CT.gov results', 'no linked publications', and 'all endpoints match the registered primary' — COAPT and MITRA-FR both have posted results and publications, and all-cause mortality is NOT the registered primary.
other_confirmed_errors.RM-H01: TSA/RIS incoherence: RIS 1365 < N 1426 while reporting 36% / 7%.
other_confirmed_errors.RM-I01: NNT inconsistency: 67 vs 11 vs a pictogram showing 9/100.
other_confirmed_errors.RM-F06: PRISMA does not reconcile: 123 assessed - 34 excluded != 3 included.
other_confirmed_errors.RM-E01: template contamination: 'across CKD trials', 'compared with placebo' (comparator is GDMT), the storage key mitral_funcmr, 'MACE'.

PCSK9_REVIEW.html.why: Detector-validation case. The two trial rows are CORRECT to source; every defect is structural — scope, contamination, machinery, completeness. Records that a clean extraction does not make a sound review.

confirmed_errors.RM-A13: FOURIER's composite includes coronary REVASCULARISATION; ODYSSEY's does not and uses CHD death rather than CV death. Different constructs pooled under one scope label.
confirmed_errors.RM-E03: the monitored registry watchlist (CTGOV_EVIDENCE_REGISTRY) tracks FINERENONE trials — FIDELIO-DKD, FIGARO-DKD, FINEARTS-HF, ARTS-DN, FINE-ONE, CONFIDENCE. The entire live-monitoring surface is the wrong drug class.
confirmed_errors.RM-B08: k=2 (FOURIER + ODYSSEY only). A prior published synthesis found 38 RCTs (MACE OR 0.83, 0.78-0.88). SPIRE-1/2, OSLER-1/2 and ODYSSEY LONG TERM are absent — the strings SPIRE and OSLER do not occur anywhere in the file. SPIRE is a NEGATIVE agent (bococizumab, stopped for immunogenicity); omitting it while retaining positive agents is selection bias, the same class as the omitted-trial finding in ATTR-CM.
confirmed_errors.RM-B01: the mortality / MI / stroke selectors all resolve to the MACE counts: the ACM, MI and Stroke rows carry tE:null, cE:null, so the scope falls back to the primary.
confirmed_errors.RM-F01: green badge over __verdict = UNCERTAIN with n_trials_seen = 0.
confirmed_errors.RM-E01: FINERENONE_REVIEW.tailwind.css stylesheet link; FIDELIO/FIGARO in the evidence registry; uacr/albuminuria in the screening relevance scorer.
confirmed_errors.RM-G01: safeRob present with the low-fallback; ODYSSEY stores some-concerns on D3 and D5 and renders Low.
confirmed_errors.RM-H01: funnel / Egger / trim-fill at k=2; Copas at k=2 (needs 15).
confirmed_errors.RM-J07: trial counts disagree across surfaces [0, 2] and a NaN renders, while the gate asserts a pass.

BEMPEDOIC_ACID_REVIEW.html.why: Carries the wrong-NCT foreign-eligibility defect with a fully verified counter-example, plus a self-contradicting effect estimate and NULLED ghost rows.

truth.attribution: Nissen SE et al. 2023 N Engl J Med is the CVOT publication. A 2022/2026 post-hoc is not the trial report.

truth.internally_impossible: 108/1488 vs 40/742 gives a crude RR of 1.346 — the displayed HR 0.75 is on the OPPOSITE side of 1 from the app's own counts.
truth.misattributed_pooled: REPORTED but NOT REPRODUCED in this file: the reviewer states 0.75 (0.56-1.00) reproduces an earlier published TWO-TRIAL POOLED RR 0.75 (0.56-0.99) over ~3008 participants, i.e. a pooled estimate displayed as a trial-level HR. The file's own PUBLISHED_META_BENCHMARKS does not contain that record, so this remains a source-verification task, not a confirmed static finding.
truth.row_state: NULLED placeholder key while the bare NCT02666664 is still referenced in AUTO_INCLUDE_TRIAL_IDS and bempedoicIds

confirmed_errors.RM-A07: REPORTED: the LDL-C selector renders 'Pooled Hazard Ratio = -19.50 / 2050% lower hazard' — a negative HR is mathematically impossible; -19.50 is a continuous mean difference forced through the HR reporting template. RENDER-class: the string is computed at runtime and is not present statically. The static precondition IS present: CONTINUOUS LDL-C rows (md -17.4 etc.) reachable by the HR reporting path, which RM-A05 detects.
